what: Database rule run for the interaction kit (Reference_Build_Plan.md, Step 2): guide progress and undo of library edits
how: One transaction against the Supabase project comms-hub, rolled back at the end. Throwaway accounts (@t.test) for director, assistant and writer act through row level security. In the site each action is its own request and so its own transaction id; the script gives each action's steps their own id (pg_temp.cut) to stand for that.
rules_checked: guide progress: seen, a section tip, a malformed key refused, replaying a page forgets the page and its tips, guides off; nobody else reads it
an upload is not undoable; a rename is, labelled in Arabic; another person neither sees nor undoes it
the undo puts the old name back, the activity log records an undo, the undo is not itself undoable, and it works once
refused when someone else changed the file since (the tags stay)
a stage move on the board is undone back past the forward-only pipeline; a decision (approval) is not undoable, nor the move into review it settled
a move between folders is labelled with the folder; the undo checks the rights again (view only in the folder: refused; the right back: allowed)
a folder lock and its undo; a folder access grant and its undo
an action older than an hour is gone; a system write (the work sync) is not a step
an approved file keeps its name
a rename that Drive refuses is cancelled by the server without an undo in the log
an undo that Drive refuses to follow is taken forward again and offered again
after: no steps, no guide progress, no test files or accounts left

advisors.security: no new kind of finding: guide_update, undo_list, undo_action, undo_cancel_last and undo_reapply are the intended callable functions; undo_apply, undo_capture and undo_row_hash are not callable
